title: Lost in Aggregation: How Benchmarks Overlook Irreplaceable Model Strengths
abstract: arXiv:2608.18919v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular machine learning benchmarks typically summarize performance by averaging scores, ranks, or pairwise wins across datasets. Such aggregates are useful for selecting robust default models, but they can obscure a different question: which models are necessary to attain peak performance on particular datasets? We argue that benchmark evaluation should also consider the data-centric peak performance frontier, defined by the best statistically supported performance achieved on each dataset. From this perspective, a model may be irreplaceable, sufficient, redundant, or fallible depending on where it lies on the frontier relative to other models. Applying this framework to the TabArena benchmark, we find that common aggregation metrics are highly correlated and largely measure consistency and avoiding failures, while being much less aligned with dataset-level irreplaceability. translated_title: 迷失在聚合中：基准如何忽视不可替代的模型优势
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18919v1 公告类型：新 摘要：表格机器学习基准通常通过平均分数、排名或跨数据集的成对胜率来总结性能。这类聚合指标有助于选择稳健的默认模型，但它们可能掩盖另一个问题：哪些模型对于在特定数据集上达到最佳性能是必要的？我们认为，基准评估还应考虑以数据为中心的峰值性能前沿，该前沿由每个数据集上统计支持的最佳性能定义。从这个角度来看，一个模型可能是不可替代的、足够的、冗余的或易出错的，这取决于它相对于其他模型在前沿上的位置。将此框架应用于TabArena基准，我们发现常见的聚合指标高度相关，且主要衡量一致性和避免失败，而与数据集级别的不可替代性一致性较低。因此，在数据集上表现尚可的模型可能会被忽视其独特优势。
tldr: 本文提出从数据为中心的峰值性能前沿评估模型，揭示常用聚合指标忽视不可替代的模型优势，并指出这些指标与数据集级不可替代性相关性低。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes evaluating models via a data-centric peak performance frontier, revealing that common aggregation metrics overlook irreplaceable model strengths and correlate poorly with dataset-level irreplaceability.
